request.state:
L01: The panel heard the case over two afternoons.
L02: Both sides made a written statement in advance.
L03: The written statements were exchanged a week before the hearing.
L04: The panel asked for one further document.
L05: That document arrived the following morning.
L06: The ruling was read out at the close of the second afternoon.
L07: A written copy of the ruling was sent the next day.
L08: The ruling explains which parts of the claim were upheld.
L09: An appeal is heard by a different panel.
L10: The appeal panel does not hear new evidence.
L11: The registrar answers questions about how to lodge an appeal.
L12: The registrar's telephone line is open on weekday afternoons.

q1.instructions: Which line states the deadline for lodging an appeal against the ruling?
